      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv('/content/dataset_custos_transporte_pas_ibge.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "df.head()"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Histograma\n",
        "df[\"total_de_custos_mil_reais\"].plot.hist(bins=32, color=\"blue\", alpha=0.5);\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Total de custos (mil reais)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Frequência\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribuição do Total de Custos\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Gráfico de dispersão\n",
        "plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.yscale(\"log\")\n",
        "\n",
        "sct_plot = sns.scatterplot(\n",
        "    x=df[\"combustiveis_lubrificantes_mil_reais\"],\n",
        "    y=df[\"total_de_custos_mil_reais\"],\n",
        "    hue=df[\"atividade\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "sct_plot.set_xlabel(\n",
        "    \"Combustíveis e lubrificantes (mil reais)\",\n",
        "    fontsize=12\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "sct_plot.set_ylabel(\n",
        "    \"Total de custos (mil reais)\",\n",
        "    fontsize=12\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Boxplot\n",
        "ax = df.boxplot(\n",
        "    column=\"total_de_custos_mil_reais\",\n",

        "    figsize=(15,6)\n",
        ")\n",

        "    xlabel=\"\",\n",

        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Total de Custos por Atividade\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.suptitle(\"\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Heatmap\n",
        "\n",
        "df_ = df[\n",
        "    [\n",
        "        \"total_de_custos_mil_reais\",\n",
        "        \"mercadorias_consumo_reposicao_mil_reais\",\n",
        "        \"custo_mercadorias_revendidas_mil_reais\",\n",
        "        \"combustiveis_lubrificantes_mil_reais\",\n",
        "        \"outros_custos_mil_reais\"\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    df_.corr(),\n",
        "    annot=True,\n",
        "    fmt=\".2f\",\n",
        "    cmap=\"coolwarm\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Matriz de Correlação dos Custos\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
